CustomField.label: Bedrock Region
CustomField.description: Identifies the sales region for this opportunity for use in the Bedrock Dynamic Process Framework. The existing Region__c formula field is read-only; this field provides a writable region classification.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the geographic region this opportunity is managed from: West, East, APAC, or EMEA. Used by the Business Process Workspace component to select the correct process steps.
